name: Streaming Icons
author: Jonathan Robichaud
description: Shows each track's real streaming service icon in the browser (Spotify, Deezer, NetEase, SoundCloud, Beatport, Apple Music, USB/SD) instead of the TIDAL icon on every track that EngineX plays through TIDAL. Built for SC LIVE 4 on EngineX 5.3.0.4.
